title: Super Mario Clouds for 10 Minutes. Marc Weidenbaum got Cory Arcangel’s just-the-clouds...
content:
Super Mario Clouds for 10 Minutes. Marc Weidenbaum got Cory Arcangel’s just-the-clouds version of Super Mario Bros. (featured in the 2004 Whitney Biennial) to run on a modern portable gaming device. Looks great!
